conviction_board.narrative: HEROMOTOCO scores 25/100 on our engine. Price has reclaimed its 200-day average — the first hurdle for any recovery. But the 50-day hasn't confirmed yet, so this is early days. Momentum is flat — RSI at 51 sits in no-man's land. The stock is waiting for a trigger. Volume is thin (0.6x) — take any move with a pinch of salt. Market headwinds are real — 33% breadth in a bearish regime means even good setups get sold. Automobiles is lagging the broader tape (score 11) — an extra headwind. Downside risk towards ₹5,151 is real. Capital preservation first. Verdict: HOLD. Own it? Let it work. Don't own it? Cleaner entries exist elsewhere. Outlook: Bearish → Bearish → Bearish.
